text:
maria-pm: FYI we just got a P1 from Eli (support) — BetaCorp's private deployment started returning garbled responses after the 2026-11 model bump. They say it worked on hosted but fails on their VPC setup. Can we triage scope + release path?

eli-support: Reproduced locally on a mimic private stack. Error looks like KV-cache desync on long-context sessions. Sending logs. :link: (customer logs pasted below)

eli-support: ```
ERR inference/runtime: kv-cache-mismatch: expected 0x1f, got 0x00 at token 1024
stack: runtime.go:223 Serve -> kv_cache.go:87 applyPatch
```

raj-eng: Thanks — initial guess is the runtime's cache-invalidations change in the new kernel selection path. Could be a quantization edge with our private deployment build. I need a repro with a minimal prompt and model binary. Eli can you attach the model hash?

eli-support: Model hash: b6a9f0c. Minimal prompt: "summarize: <very long doc>". Happens when > 1024 tokens. Customer also had custom tokenization turned on.

sophie-csm: BetaCorp is on an annual contract, they use Dedicated + Private for PHI. They're stressed, will need an ETA and comms. CSM requests either a hot patch or a clear timeline for a next release with a workaround.

raj-eng: Options: 1) emergency patch to revert the cache invalidation optimization (fast, breaks perf improvements) and ship as a hotfix to Private installs; 2) Canary a targeted fix on a few private tenants (requires coordination + infra windows); 3) Schedule for next minor release in 3 weeks with full QA — slower.

lena-release: If we opt for hotfix, we need: PR + changelog, security signoff, infra migration job, and a rollback plan. We can do hotfix within 48–72h if eng has a patch ready. Canary needs a deploy window and customer opt-in.

qa-ana: We can sanity test a revert path in ~12h and run a quick long-context regression suite (~6h more). But full matrix (quantization + tokenization variations) is 2–3 days.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2987 assigned to raj-eng, severity P1. Pager on-call notified.

raj-eng: I'm going to attempt a revert of the cache invalidation in a branch. If successful, I'll open a PR and mark it hotfix-ready. Question: do we push the hotfix to BetaCorp's private control plane directly or provide them a patch bundle? Their env is air-gapped.

lena-release: For air-gapped customers we provide a signed patch bundle + install instructions. Release team will handle signing and delivery. We'll need the customer's SFTP details or a secure transfer method.

eli-support: I have the contact for their infra lead (jarod@betacorp). Will coordinate transfer.

maria-pm: Priority decision: we should aim for a hotfix because this blocks production for them and risk is high (PHI). But want eng to confirm risk of reverting perf change. Raj, if revert introduces a new regression we fall back to canary plan. Confirm timeline and I'll draft CSM comms.

raj-eng: Revert risk is low — mostly a performance regression. I can have a PR by EOD and a validated patch by tomorrow midday if nothing else fails.

qa-ana: Once PR is up ping me, I'll run the long-context regression. If green, we can sign-off for hotfix.

lena-release: Tentative schedule: PR -> hotfix build -> QA signoff -> signing -> patch bundle ready ~24–36h. If we need canary, add +8h for infra ops to schedule.

sophie-csm: I'll prepare the customer comms: acknowledgement, mitigation steps, ETA, and temporary workaround: reduce max_context to 1024 and disable custom tokenization (they may lose accuracy but it's a stop-gap).

raj-eng: Noted. I'll start the revert branch now. @deploy-bot once we have a build we'll request a staged deploy to our internal canary and then prepare the signed bundle.

deploy-bot: Build requested: job/37822 started. Will post artifact link when complete. :construction: 

maria-pm: Thanks team — I'll own the external comms and coordinate with Sophie. Keep updates here.

eli-support: Adding customer contact details and repro clip to the incident ticket.

lena-release: Also: let's add a short release note for customers explaining the regression and the fix path so that support and sales have consistent language.

raj-eng: Update: PR opened — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5423. Revert change and add a guarded config flag. QA asked for smoke results first.

qa-ana: Smoke looks clean on the revert build. Starting long-context regression now.

maria-pm: Great — keep timestamps in the incident. If QA passes, we proceed with hotfix bundle delivery to BetaCorp.

(ends)
